crop.notes: Theatre Comique advertisement in the Amusements column; complete.

ocr.notes: Gist readable; names garbled (Heygster as 'BEYGMTiR', 'massive silver goblet' as 'Wassive silver godiet').

title.suggested: Theatre Comique Advertises Benefit for Tom Allen

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican carried a Theatre Comique advertisement for a grand benefit for Tom Allen that evening, at which he would spar with Ned Donnelly and be presented with the disputed McCoole belt.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The St. Louis Republican, Thursday Morning, March 30, 1876, page 5. Filed as Missouri Republican per the rubric (pre-1888).

facts.fact: A grand benefit for Allen was held at the Theatre Comique, Pine Street between Third and Fourth, St. Louis, where he was to spar with gloves with Ned Donnelly
places: Theatre Comique, Pine Street between Third and Fourth, St. Louis

facts.fact: Allen was to be presented with the disputed McCoole belt at his benefit

notes: The bill also included a wrestling match between Bauer and Christol, with Allen to present a silver goblet to the winner and Wilhelm Heygster as referee.
